title: Core accounting, audit, tax and sustainability research directory
counting_note: These are twenty manually curated research tracks, not twenty acquired standards, articles or completed corpus families. They are original topic outlines; no protected publisher body was indexed or copied.

entries.title: Accounting Standards Codification
research_questions: Which reporting entity, transaction and reporting period are in scope?
Which topic, subtopic, section and paragraph apply?
Is a paragraph current, pending, superseded or subject to transition relief?
entries.original_work_product: A period-specific issue memo with source identifiers, assumptions and unresolved judgments

entries.title: Accounting Standards Updates
entries.scope: Changes to the Codification and transition research
research_questions: Which existing paragraphs change?
What entity categories and interim/annual periods are affected?
What adoption method, elections and disclosures require confirmation?
entries.original_work_product: An amendment-to-Codification change log; do not treat a project announcement as an amended rule

entries.title: Historical pronouncements and basis materials
research_questions: What date and historical authority question require the older material?
Has that material been superseded or incorporated elsewhere?
entries.original_work_product: A historical-authority map that keeps explanatory history separate from governing text

entries.title: Governmental Accounting Research System
entries.scope: State and local governmental financial reporting
research_questions: Is the reporting unit a government, component unit or another type of entity?
Which fund and government-wide perspectives must be reconciled?
What basis and measurement focus apply to each statement?
entries.original_work_product: A reporting-entity and statement-level authority map

entries.title: Statements, Interpretations and other pronouncements
entries.scope: Original issuances and their subsequent amendments
research_questions: What is the issuance date versus the effective reporting period?
Which statements amend the original requirement?
Are leases, subscriptions, pensions, OPEB, capital assets or debt implicated?
entries.original_work_product: A versioned applicability register organized by issue and reporting period

entries.title: Implementation guidance
research_questions: Which facts make the example relevant?
Is the answer current after later pronouncements?
Which judgment remains specific to the reporting entity?
entries.original_work_product: An original fact-to-guidance worksheet with unresolved exceptions, not copied question-and-answer banks

entries.title: SAS / AU-C auditing standards
research_questions: Is the engagement within the nonissuer audit framework?
How do risk assessment, responses, evidence and reporting connect?
What current codified sections and amendments govern this engagement period?
entries.original_work_product: An original audit research map and evidence-request checklist

entries.title: SSAE / AT-C attestation standards
research_questions: What subject matter, criteria, intended users and engagement type are specified?
Which report form and assurance level are contemplated?
What independence and evidence questions require confirmation?
entries.original_work_product: An engagement-scoping worksheet separating examination, review and agreed-upon procedures research

entries.title: SSARS / AR-C preparation, compilation and review standards
research_questions: Which service was actually engaged?
What management responsibilities and reporting language are relevant?
Does another framework govern the entity or engagement?
entries.original_work_product: A service-selection and deliverables checklist that does not imply an audit opinion

entries.title: Quality management standards
entries.scope: Firm systems and engagement quality research
research_questions: What quality objectives and risks are relevant to the firm?
Who owns design, implementation, monitoring and remediation?
How is the engagement-quality review requirement determined?
entries.original_work_product: A responsibility/evidence matrix linking firm policies to demonstrable controls

entries.title: Code of Professional Conduct
research_questions: Which professional role and covered relationships matter?
What facts may create an independence or conflict concern?
What authoritative interpretation and documentation are needed?
entries.original_work_product: An independence fact register and escalation memo; no automated eligibility conclusion

entries.title: Audit and accounting guides and practice aids
research_questions: Which edition, industry and entity class match the engagement?
Which passages are authoritative requirements versus implementation commentary?
What separate publisher permissions cover product use?
entries.original_work_product: An industry issue list with source edition and authority classification

entries.title: ISSB IFRS S1 and IFRS S2
research_questions: Which jurisdiction has adopted which edition or modified requirements?
What reporting boundary, materiality lens and time horizon apply?
Which transition reliefs and local filing rules require confirmation?
entries.original_work_product: A jurisdiction-and-period applicability matrix; no claim of universal legal adoption

entries.title: SASB industry-based materials
research_questions: Which business activities and industry classification describe the entity?
Which metrics, boundaries and estimation methods need evidence?
How does this use relate to an applicable reporting framework?
entries.original_work_product: An original metric inventory with units, boundaries, owners and source-rights status

entries.title: GRI Universal, Sector and Topic Standards
research_questions: What impacts, stakeholders and material topics are relevant?
Which applicable editions and sector guidance need review?
How will metric evidence, omissions and reporting boundaries be documented?
entries.original_work_product: An impact-topic research plan; publisher text requires an appropriate software/content permission

entries.title: GHG Protocol standards and guidance
research_questions: What organizational and operational boundaries are chosen?
What activity data, factors, units and calculation methods support each metric?
What inventory changes, estimation limitations and assurance evidence must be tracked?
entries.original_work_product: An original calculation-and-provenance workbook; standards text and tools retain their own terms

entries.title: EU CSRD and ESRS legal texts
research_questions: Which undertaking, jurisdiction, reporting year and reporting wave apply?
Which final Official Journal act and amendments govern the period?
Is a document final law, consolidated aid, proposal, draft standard or implementation guidance?
entries.original_work_product: A CELEX-based legal version chain and article/annex evidence map

entries.title: U.S. federal and state sustainability disclosure requirements
entries.scope: Separate federal rules, state statutes, regulations and litigation status
research_questions: What regulator and entity thresholds apply?
Is the requirement proposed, adopted, stayed, amended or rescinded?
What court orders or state implementation materials change the conclusion?
entries.original_work_product: A jurisdiction-specific status ledger; do not transfer one regulator’s status to another

entries.title: Revenue rulings, procedures, notices and Internal Revenue Bulletins
entries.scope: Published federal tax guidance and historical amendments
research_questions: Is this advance guidance or published in the Internal Revenue Bulletin?
What legislation, regulations and later guidance amend or supersede it?
What taxable period and taxpayer facts are relevant?
entries.original_work_product: A dated guidance chain that distinguishes precedent, advance releases and explanatory material

entries.title: Substantive instructions and publications
entries.scope: Practical tax administration guidance and edition history
research_questions: Which tax year, form revision and substantive issue match the problem?
Does later law override the informal guidance?
Are language editions or reissued files duplicates for the requested scope?
entries.original_work_product: An edition-aware reference map; forms and page fragments do not inflate article counts
